# Prevent directory listings in the htaccess for Apache

Some hosting providers, by default, do not prevent directory listings. We frequently encounter merchants whose directories can be viewed because of the absence of an `index.php` file, particularly when their hosting hasn't been configured correctly to restrict directory listings. Consequently, when these directories are accessed online, a list of files becomes visible. This poses a security risk, especially in cases where custom directories contain configuration files or other resources that shouldn't be publicly accessible.

## Attendu
The directly listing should be prevented in the htaccess.

## Étapes
To reproduce the issue, the Apache server should not enforce the Indexes.
The accessing to a directory (https://example.test/directory_notprotected) will [display the list of files](https://ibb.co/xDp4CnY).

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
